thread:
Maya: Quick sync — I drafted three headline variants for the tri-mode landing (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Posting them here for quick reactions.

Liam: sending

Maya: 1) "Redwood Inference: Predictable LLM inference for every scale" 2) "Ship LLM features faster — hosted, dedicated, or private" 3) "Inference that matches your SLAs, not your headaches" — which lands for launch-posts + hero?

Sofia: I like #2 for product clarity, but for enterprise pages (#3) feels stronger. Could we show #2 on top-level hero and #3 on Dedicated/Private sections?

Ethan: agree. For social launch posts: tease with #2 and then carousel posts that call out cost/latency bench for each mode. Need a benchmark narrative line: "<5ms median token latency on hosted for demo workloads; Dedicated scales to X rps; Private for regulatory isolation." Thoughts?

Nora: make sure we don't promise concrete numbers in public docs without internal sign-off. Maybe say "sub-xx ms" is risky. Use relational language: "low-latency hosted demo profiles, scalable Dedicated pools, and air-gapped Private options." Then link to benchmark deck in Notion.

Maya: good call. I'll soften metrics. For webinar: proposed title — "Serving LLMs in Production: Choosing Hosted, Dedicated, or Private". We should run a short poll on the site / signup copy to route leads by intent.

Liam: routing idea: when someone signs up for webinar or downloads the benchmark, collect a single dropdown: "primary interest" with values: Hosted (PLG/demo), Dedicated (predictable capacity), Private (VPC/on-prem). Then map to queues.

Sofia: mapping table (quick):
```
Hosted -> growth-sales / demo-booking
Dedicated -> dedicated-ops / enterprise-ASE
Private -> solutions-eng / security-sales
```

inbound-bot: Note: form field "primary interest" will be stored on lead and available in CRM as lead_interest.

Ethan: perfect. For copy iteration on landing pages, propose micro-copy variants for CTAs: 
- Hosted: "Try hosted API — free credits"
- Dedicated: "Talk to sales about reserved capacity"
- Private: "Request a private deployment consultation"
Which should be primary CTA vs secondary?

Maya: primary CTA should map to the visitor segment: default hero CTA = Hosted trial (PLG), secondary = Learn about Dedicated, tertiary = Private consult. But for enterprise pages linked from ads, flip to Dedicated/Private primary.

Nora: for launch posts cadence: day 0 hero blog + benchmark highlights, day 2 webinar invite, day 5 case study snippet + gated benchmark. Keep each post with a short metric-forward blurb and CTA to the relevant landing. Use UTM tags: utm_campaign=tri-mode-launch, utm_content={hosted|dedicated|private}.

Liam: can ops set up auto-routing in HubSpot: if lead_interest==Hosted then assign to growth-sales, if Dedicated -> enterprise queue, Private -> solutions? Also set lead_score for webinar registrants +1.

inbound-bot: HubSpot workflow recommended: if form.submitted and form.page contains "tri-mode-landing" then set property lead_interest = form.primary_interest; assign owner by interest; add tag "tri-mode-launch".

Maya: copy request to content: can someone A/B test hero lines #2 vs #3 for the Dedicated page? Small traffic split (10/90) for 2 weeks. Also need two social captions per channel (LinkedIn long, X short).

Sofia: I'll write LinkedIn drafts, Liam can shorten for X. Also need slide 1 of webinar deck to be a one-sentence problem statement: "Inference is where model ROI meets engineering constraints."

Ethan: timeline check: final copy by Wed EOD, assets to design Thurs, dev deploy next Tues. Nora — ok to push UTM/dev routing?

Nora: yes, I'll create the HubSpot form + workflow today and tag the dev ticket. Ticket: #MARK-4123.

Maya: thanks team. Quick action items: Sofia drafts LinkedIn + two hero variants by EOD, Liam sets up AB test in Growthstack, Nora finalizes HubSpot workflow, Ethan preps benchmark blurbs without hard numbers. We'll reconvene Mon to review slides. :thumbsup:
